description: This Java class 'DefaultActorService' initializes and manages an actor system within the Thingsboard server, including setting up dispatchers, creating root actors, handling application events, and shutting down the actor system.

classes.name: DefaultActorService
classes.description: Service class responsible for initializing, configuring, and managing the actor system within the Thingsboard server, including event handling and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: initActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the actor system, creates dispatchers, root actors, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: initDispatcherExecutor
methods.description: Creates an ExecutorService for a dispatcher based on the pool size, using a thread factory or work-stealing pool.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles application ready event to send initialization message to the actor system.

methods.name: onTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles partition change events and forwards them to the actor system.

methods.name: filterTbApplicationEvent
methods.description: Filters partition change events based on service type.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Gracefully stops the actor system during shutdown.
